lines.en: As both the school day and my counseling hours come to an end, I’m left with nothing to do but mindlessly roam the halls in hopes of encountering someone or something.
lines.zh: 随着放学和我的心理咨询时间一同结束，我无事可做，只能在走廊里漫无目的地游荡，盼着能撞见什么人或什么事。

lines.en: And while it is true that I carry a small, electronic device that enables me to create {i}opportunities{/i} for things to happen, I find that it’s often more interesting to let the world decide my schedule instead.
lines.zh: 虽然我身上确实带着一个小小的电子设备，能让我为事情的发生创造{i}机会{/i}，可我发现，让世界来决定我的日程往往更有趣。

lines.en: As such, here I am — alone and melancholic, letting the warm sun creep through the windows and illuminate my body with the light and luster of longing and loss.
lines.zh: 于是，我在这儿了——孤独又忧郁，任温暖的阳光从窗户爬进来，用渴望与失落的光和泽照亮我的身体。

lines.en: What I long for is a way to fill this void with something that won’t sink through my stomach when I lie in bed tonight.
lines.zh: 我渴望的，是找到什么东西来填满这个空洞，好让我今晚躺在床上时，它不会沉进我的胃里。

lines.en: What I’ve lost is the will to make that happen.
lines.zh: 我失去的，是让那件事发生的意志。
还是说，我没有失去？
: 嗯……嗯嗯！

lines.en: I enter the library and come face to face with what I’m pretty sure is my first soirée into the cliché, yet realistic trope of a short girl trying to reach something on a shelf that’s just a little too high.
lines.zh: 我走进图书馆，迎面撞上的，大概是我第一次亲身经历那个老套却又真实的桥段——一个矮个子女孩正努力去够书架上就差那么一点点高的东西。

lines.en: This, of course, opens up a window of infinite choices on how I’m going to tackle the situation.
lines.zh: 这当然为我打开了一扇窗，里面是无穷无尽的处理方式。

lines.en: Would it be best to just stand here and wait for her to ask for my help?
lines.zh: 是就这么站在这儿等她开口求我帮忙最好？

lines.en: Should I take the more aggressive and dramatic approach of lifting her up and letting her grab her desired book on her own?
lines.zh: 还是该采取更强势、更有戏剧性的做法，直接把她举起来，让她自己拿到想要的那本书？

lines.en: Or should I maybe plunge this world into total chaos, knocking the shelf completely over and potentially killing Uta in the process?
lines.zh: 又或者，我该把整个世界推入彻底的混乱，把整个书架掀翻，说不定顺带把 Uta 砸死？
可能性无穷无尽。
: 嗯嗯嗯嗯！！

lines.en: But if I don’t do something soon, Uta could dislocate or permanently damage her arm- which would make it harder for her to provide daily handjobs to me when we are ultimately married.
lines.zh: 可如果我不赶紧做点什么，Uta 可能会脱臼或者永久性地伤到胳膊——那会让她在我们最终结婚之后更难每天给我打手枪。

lines.en: So, I guess I’ll cut her some slack and lend a hand so that I may one day fully experience hers.
lines.zh: 所以，我想我就放她一马，搭把手，好让我有一天能完整地体验她的那只手。
: 哈？你从哪儿冒出来的？

lines.en: : Which one are you trying to reach?
lines.zh: : 你想拿哪一本？

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...that red history book a little to the right. I can’t really see the full title from all the way down here.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……右边那本红色的历史书。从下面这儿我看不清完整的书名。

lines.en: : And you were reaching for it anyway? Since when is your interest in history that pure?
lines.zh: : 可你还是伸手去够？你对历史的兴趣什么时候纯正到这个地步了？

lines.en: : My interest in history doesn’t exist. I just texted Futaba asking which one covers some of the stuff Imani’s been teaching us lately and...this is me following her directions.
lines.zh: : 我对历史根本没兴趣。我刚给 Futaba 发了短信，问哪一本涵盖了 Imani 最近教我们的那些内容，然后……这就是我照着她的指示做的。

lines.en: : Or trying to at least. She forgot to mention this book had a height requirement.
lines.zh: : 或者说，尽力在照做。她忘了提这本书有身高要求。
: 给。这本，对吧？
: 对。就是这本。

lines.en: : What do you want in return, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你想要什么回报？
: 回报？

lines.en: : I know how this works, Sensei. {i}You{/i} hand me the book. Then {i}I{/i} try to thank you. Then you say something like, “Thanks ain’t enough, sugar. There’s somethin’ else I’m after, ” while staring at my body.
lines.zh: : 我知道这套路怎么走，Sensei。{i}你{/i}把书递给我。然后{i}我{/i}试着向{i}你{/i}道谢。然后你就说些“光说谢谢可不够，甜心。我要的是别的东西”之类的话，一边盯着我的身体。

lines.en: : You could have at least made the dialogue more...{i}me-{/i}like. I can’t really envision ever calling anyone “sugar.”
lines.zh: : 你至少可以把台词写得……更{i}像我{/i}一点。我真的想象不出自己会叫谁“甜心”。

lines.en: : Just tell me what kinda prize you’re after so I can figure out whether or not the book is of equal value.
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我你想要什么样的奖赏，我好判断这本书值不值这个价。

lines.en: : I was going to give it to you out of the kindness of my heart. But now, I’m curious as to what I can actually {i}get{/i} for it.
lines.zh: : 我本来是出于纯粹的善意要给它的。不过现在，我很好奇它究竟能替我{i}换来{/i}什么。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} were gonna do something out of the kindness of your heart? Even though this is the exact type of tropey situation guys like you dream about? I’m surprised you didn’t just pick me up.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}会出于善意做事？哪怕这正是你们这种男人梦寐以求的老套场景？我还惊讶你居然没有直接把我举起来。

lines.en: : You should be happy I didn’t pick you up. If I did, who even knows when I’d be willing to put you down again?
lines.zh: : 你该庆幸我没把你举起来。我要是真举了，谁知道我还肯不肯把你放下来。

lines.en: : So you’re after the whole package after all, huh?
lines.zh: : 这么说，你果然是想要整套啊？
: 或者只要一个吻。

lines.en: : Why does that embarrass you more than the “whole package?”
lines.zh: : 为什么这个比“整套”还让你害臊？
: 那套里不包括接吻！
: 那包括什么？

lines.en: : A night of fiery passion, a morning of deep regret, several moments of intense pelvic pain, and a phone call to my parents! Nobody ever said anything about kissing!
lines.zh: : 一夜炽热的激情、一早深沉的悔恨、几阵剧烈的骨盆疼痛，还有一通打给我爸妈的电话！从来没人说过要接吻！

lines.en: : In that case, I will take one night of fiery passion. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，我要一夜炽热的激情。谢了。

lines.en: : No, that doesn’t work either! I was just listing the contents! I never agreed to the fiery passion!
lines.zh: : 不，那也不行！我只是在列举内容！我从没同意过什么炽热的激情！
: 拿着书吧，Uta。
: 我可以吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Like I said, I planned on doing this out of the kindness of my heart and was fully prepared to keep all of my fantasies about you to myself.
lines.zh: : 可以。就像我说的，我本来就打算出于善意做这件事，也早就准备好把所有关于你的幻想都藏在心里。

lines.en: : Just...out of curiosity...are we talkin’ like...one or two fantasies? Or...
lines.zh: : 只是……出于好奇……我们说的是……一两个幻想？还是……
: 你少说了大概十个零。
: 十……个零？
: 我说了我说的。
: 那幻想也太多了……

lines.en: : I’m starting to think you don’t even want this book.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得你根本不想要这本书了。
: 你真的……
: “啊——哈”什么？我为什么被“啊——哈”了？

lines.en: : You’re just messing with me! You think throwing out a huge number with ten zeros will get me to compromise and give you some kind of consolation prize! I know your tricks!
lines.zh: : 你就是在耍我！你觉得抛出一个带十个零的巨大数字，就能让我妥协、给你某种安慰奖！我识破你的把戏了！

lines.en: : There are no tricks. You’re just a little delusional and very sexually repressed.
lines.zh: : 没有什么把戏。你只是有点妄想，而且性压抑得很严重。

lines.en: : That may be true! But the library isn’t the place to discuss it!
lines.zh: : 这倒也许是事实！可图书馆不是讨论这个的地方！

lines.en: : Shall we take this outside then?
lines.zh: : 那我们出去谈？
: 出去？！你是暴露狂吗？！
: 我{i}可以{/i}是。
: 我就知道！

lines.en: : So, do you get like this every time someone gets something off of a shelf for you?
lines.zh: : 那么，每次有人替你从架子上拿东西，你都会变成这样吗？

lines.en: : We all do. Everyone knows that us short girls wait our entire lives for tall people like you to walk by and remind us of all the things we can’t do on our own. It really gets us going.
lines.zh: : 我们都会。谁都知道，像我们这样的矮个子女孩，一辈子都在等像你这样的高个子路过，提醒我们自己有多少事做不到。这真的让我们很来劲。

lines.en: : Wow. I really should have just picked you up, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。我真该直接把你举起来的，是吧？

lines.en: : I...I can’t think of a safe way to answer that question, so I’m just going to take my book now! Thank you!
lines.zh: : 我……我想不出一个安全的答案来接这句话，所以我就直接拿走我的书了！谢谢！

lines.en: Uta snatches the book out of my hands and retreats to the corner of the library to...presumably read it.
lines.zh: Uta 一把从我手里抢过书，撤退到图书馆的角落里……大概是去读了。

lines.en: But seeing as the world has decided that {i}she{/i} will be the one to fill my void today, I have other things in mind.
lines.zh: 不过既然世界已经决定由{i}她{/i}来填满我今天的空洞，那我心里想的就是别的事。
: 你……要留下来陪我？
: 有问题吗？

lines.en: : It’s not a problem. I just thought it was kind of obvious that I need to study, so...I don’t want to bore you or anything.
lines.zh: : 没问题。我只是觉得我要学习这件事挺明显的，所以……我不想让你觉得无聊什么的。

lines.en: : I’ll never be bored while I’m looking at you, Uta.
lines.zh: : 只要看着你，我就永远不会无聊，Uta。

lines.en: : Could you maybe...stop saying stuff like that to me? Just...Just for today, I mean. I’m not going to be able to focus if you’re all...flirty like that.
lines.zh: : 你能不能……别再对我说那种话？就……就今天，我是说。你要是老是那么……撩我，我没法集中精神。

lines.en: : Why do you need to focus in the first place? Do you actually, like...{i}care{/i} about learning all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么需要集中精神？你该不会突然……真的{i}在乎{/i}起学习来了吧？

lines.en: : I don’t really have much of a choice. I’ve been getting a lot of extra work from Imani lately so I can catch up to everybody else and stay in the class.
lines.zh: : 我其实没得选。最近 Imani 给我布置了很多额外的作业，好让我追上其他人、留在班里。

lines.en: : Stay in the class? Did she threaten to kick you out or something? Because I’m pretty sure that’s above her pay grade.
lines.zh: : 留在班里？她威胁要把你踢出去还是怎么的？因为我敢说那超出了她的职权范围。

lines.en: : I think it’s more of a testing...formality thingy than her actually wanting to get rid of me. Our grades for all those important school-wide tests get sent to our parents and mine...well...
lines.zh: : 我觉得那更像是一种考试……形式上的东西，而不是她真想赶我走。我们那些重要的全校统考成绩会寄给家长，而我爸妈……嗯……

lines.en: : Let’s just say they aren’t really the happiest when it comes to my performance. Which...is fair. I’ve been slacking off.
lines.zh: : 只能说他们对我的表现不是很满意。这……也算公平。我一直在偷懒。
: 你……需要我帮忙吗？

lines.en: : Hm? No. I appreciate the offer, but I’ll manage on my own. I get too distracted in groups.
lines.zh: : 嗯？不用。谢谢你的好意，不过我自己能搞定。我在人堆里太容易分心。

lines.en: : Well, that’s a relief because I know next to nothing about history and wouldn’t have been much help anyway.
lines.zh: : 那我就放心了，因为我对历史几乎一窍不通，反正也帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : You already did your part by being tall. Uta-chan can handle the rest. But if you want to sit there and watch her while she reads, she’ll let you do it for cheap.
lines.zh: : 你靠个子高已经出过力了。剩下的 Uta 酱自己能搞定。不过你要是想坐在那儿看她读书，她可以让你看，收费便宜。

lines.en: : How about I just help instruct Uta-chan in the subjects that I {i}do{/i} specialize in instead?
lines.zh: : 那不如换我来教 Uta 酱我{i}真正{/i}擅长的科目？

lines.en: : Is this the part where you make a biology joke?
lines.zh: : 这是你要开生物课笑话的部分吗？
: 不是。
: 是的，对吧？
: 你不懂我。

lines.en: : No, but I {i}do{/i} know your tricks. And I’m not about to let you get the upper hand on me {i}again{/i} when I’ve practically lived on the...lower...hand?
lines.zh: : 是不懂，不过我{i}确实{/i}懂你的把戏。而且我可不想{i}再{/i}让你占我的上风了——毕竟我基本上一直活在……下……手？

lines.en: : Why is “upper hand” a thing but not “lower hand?” Who comes up with phrases like that?
lines.zh: : 为什么有“占上风”这种说法，却没有“占下风”？谁想出这种词来的？

lines.en: : Again, this isn’t really an area of expertise for me. But feel free to inquire if you have any questions about cute girls or obscure poets.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这真不是我的专业领域。不过如果你对可爱女孩或者冷门诗人有什么疑问，尽管问。

lines.en: : Quite the specializations you’ve got there. Figured there’d be a few more given your {i}age and experience{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 你可真是颇有建树的专业方向。不过考虑到你的{i}年纪和经验{/i}，我本以为会再多几个。

lines.en: : There are. You just get a little too flustered whenever I talk about them.
lines.zh: : 是有的。只是每次我一聊到那些，你就太容易慌。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah......hah.....you must be...confusing me with someone else.
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈…………哈…………你一定是……把我跟别人搞混了。

lines.en: : Right, yeah. I’m probably thinking about the other Uta. If you’re Uta-chan, you’re probably not interested in me {i}at all,{/i} right?
lines.zh: : 对，没错。我想的可能是另一个 Uta。如果你是 Uta 酱，那你大概对我{i}一点{/i}兴趣都没有，对吧？

lines.en: : Did...did somebody tell you that...normal Uta {i}is?{/i}
lines.zh: : 是……是不是有人告诉你……正常的那个 Uta {i}有{/i}？
: 没有。只是直觉。

lines.en: : I figure if normal Uta {i}is{/i} interested in me, though- it’s only a matter of time until she cracks since her best friend has already given her the blessing to go ahead and make some moves.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，如果正常的那个 Uta {i}确实{/i}对我有兴趣——那她迟早会绷不住，因为她最好的朋友已经批准她可以主动出击了。

lines.en: : And I...think you might be...misreading the situation a little, but...
lines.zh: : 而我……觉得你可能……有点误读了这个局面，不过……

lines.en: : But that’s a...topic for another day! Hahah! Look at us, pretending to be all...whatever...whatever that was just now.
lines.zh: : 不过那是……改天再聊的话题！哈哈！瞧瞧我们，装出一副……管它刚才那是什么的……样子。

lines.en: : You used “flirty” a few minutes ago. I feel like that sums it up well enough.
lines.zh: : 你几分钟前用的是“撩”。我觉得这个词概括得挺到位的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...you’re like that with everybody. Is it really flirting if that’s just your default setting?
lines.zh: : 是，可是……你对谁都那样。如果那就是你的默认设置，那还算撩吗？

lines.en: : I feel like you would know, if anyone. You’re the one who’s figured out a way to monetize that setting. {i}And,{/i} on top of that, you have {i}another{/i} one you can switch to after work. I envy that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得要说有谁知道，那就是你了。你可是找到了把那个设置变现的方法。{i}而且{/i}，除此之外，你下班后还能切换到{i}另一个{/i}设置。我真羡慕。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t. It’s a lot more exhausting than I make it look. And most of the time, I’m kind of just...internally screaming.
lines.zh: : 你别羡慕。这比我表现出来的要累得多。而且大多数时候，我基本就是……在内心尖叫。
: 尖叫什么？
: （内心尖叫）
: （内心尖叫，而且还发情）
: 哦……也没什么特别的……

lines.en: : B-Besides! I’m sure there are plenty of other people who you’d like more than me. And I’m not just talking about Io or any of your other girlfriends this time either.
lines.zh: : 再、再说！我敢肯定你更喜欢的人多得是，不止我一个。而且这次我说的不只是 Io 或者你其他那些女朋友。

lines.en: : Did Io get promoted to “girlfriend” status without my knowledge?
lines.zh: : Io 在我不知情的时候升格成“女朋友”了？
: 这很难说……

lines.en: : I know you two haven’t, like...kissed and stuff yet. But I also know she actually, like...{i}talked{/i} to you.
lines.zh: : 我知道你们俩还没有……亲过什么的。不过我也知道她真的……跟你{i}谈过{/i}。
: 关于……她那件事……

lines.en: : She certainly did. Right around the same time the possibility of a triad was brought up.
lines.zh: : 她确实谈了。差不多就在提出三人行可能性的同一时间。

lines.en: : Probably goes without saying, but...Io doesn’t...talk about that kind of stuff with just anybody, Sensei. You must be really special to her if she felt comfortable enough to admit all that.
lines.zh: : 这话大概不用我说，不过……Io 不会随随便便跟谁聊那种事的，Sensei。如果她觉得足够自在、愿意把那一切都承认出来，那你对她一定非常特别。

lines.en: : You did the same thing, didn’t you? Admitted something about your past that you have trouble looking back on.
lines.zh: : 你也做了同样的事，不是吗？承认了一件你回望起来很痛苦的过去。

lines.en: : But my thing was me being young and stupid. Io was never at fault for anything she did.
lines.zh: : 可我那件事只是我年轻又愚蠢。Io 做过的任何事，从来都不是她的错。
: 你的也不是。

lines.en: : Like you said, you were young and stupid. Expecting you to make rational decisions back then would be a little...unreasonable.
lines.zh: : 就像你说的，你年轻又愚蠢。指望你那时候做出理性的决定，有点……不合理。

lines.en: : You got caught up in a feeling and did something you felt like you should do. That’s more of an accident than something done with true intent.
lines.zh: : 你被一种感觉裹挟了，然后做了你觉得该做的事。那更像是一场意外，而不是带着真正意图去做的事。

lines.en: : But it’s still...it’s still something {i}I{/i} did. That {i}I{/i} pay the price for.
lines.zh: : 可它依然是……依然是{i}我{/i}做过的事。是{i}我{/i}在为此付出代价。

lines.en: : I get that. But I’d look at you the same way whether or not any of that happened.
lines.zh: : 我明白。不过不管那件事有没有发生，我看你的方式都一样。
: 我们……那个……我们，嗯……

lines.en: : Another topic...this one is...I’m starting to feel a little...uh...
lines.zh: : 换个话题吧……这个……我开始觉得有点……呃……
: 呃……宿舍战争！你觉得……

lines.en: : How did you feel about this year?
lines.zh: : 今年怎么样？

lines.en: : It was...different. It felt more like our regular beach trip but with a few contests sprinkled in. I might just be saying that this time since there were several that didn’t involve me, though.
lines.zh: : 挺……不一样的。感觉更像我们平常的海滩之行，只是掺了几个比赛项目。不过我这么说，大概也是因为好几个项目都没我的份。

lines.en: : I agree. I think it worked for Halloween since that’s normally just a one day event, but there were a lot of girls on the beach who kind of just wanted to relax for the weekend.
lines.zh: : 我同意。我觉得万圣节那次这么做还行，因为那本来就是一天的活动；可海滩上有很多女孩，其实只想安安静静度个周末。

lines.en: : Some of the contests went pretty well, though. Like...the swimsuit one was pretty fun. And Io told me she enjoyed herself with the raft thingy. Plus, Futaba’s horror story was actually pretty cool.
lines.zh: : 不过有些比赛还挺成功的。比如……泳装那个就挺好玩。Io 跟我说她玩那个木筏的东西玩得挺开心。还有，Futaba 讲的恐怖故事其实挺酷的。
: 至于……Nodoka 那个就另说了……

lines.en: : I don’t know if I was just...maybe expecting a little too much since she’s apparently an amazing writer or...or if I just didn’t get it, but...
lines.zh: : 我不知道是不是我……也许因为她据说是个了不起的作家，我期待得有点太高了，或者……或者只是我没看懂，不过……

lines.en: : I can’t really wrap my head around whatever hers was supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 我真的搞不懂她那个到底想表达什么。

lines.en: : Do you have any thoughts, Sensei? You seemed pretty interested once she finished, so I figured that maybe there was a part of it {i}you{/i} got that I was just too dumb for.
lines.zh: : 你有什么想法吗，Sensei？她讲完的时候你看起来挺感兴趣的，所以我想也许其中有一部分{i}你{/i}看懂了，而我太笨了没看懂。
: Sensei？
: 很奇怪。

lines.en: : It definitely had some sort of effect on me, but I can barely remember any of it and...it’s hard to put into words what the effect even {i}was.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它确实对我产生了某种影响，可我几乎一点都记不得了，而且……很难用语言说清那影响到底{i}是{/i}什么。

lines.en: : Maybe it was one of those open-ended thingies? Somethin’ that people are supposed to interpret in...different ways? Like...like psychic readings or something. Do you believe in that stuff, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 也许它是那种开放式结局的东西？就是要让人们用……不同的方式去解读？像……像通灵解读什么的。你信那种东西吗，Sensei？
: 一点都不信。

lines.en: : Is that so? That’s a shame. Uta-chan was about to offer you a special palm-reading and it could have been the only chance you’ll ever get to touch her. Too bad you don’t believe in her psychic powers.
lines.zh: : 是吗？那可太遗憾了。Uta 酱本来要给你提供一次特别的手相解读，而那可能是你此生唯一一次能碰到她的机会。可惜你不信她的通灵能力。

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i} believe in psychic powers, Uta?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}信通灵能力吗，Uta？

lines.en: : Mmm...I guess a little. No more or less than most girls my age, I think.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概信一点吧。我觉得跟我这个年纪的大多数女孩差不多。

lines.en: : I’m sure a lot of it is fake, but I think there’s gotta be some kind of truth to it. Even if it’s just kinda...manifesting whatever it is the psychic tells you further down the line.
lines.zh: : 我敢说其中很多都是假的，不过我觉得总该有某种真实成分。哪怕只是……在往后的日子里把通灵者告诉你的东西给显化出来。

lines.en: : The problem with believing things in a roundabout way like that is that you’ll never really be able to prove yourself right or wrong. You’ll always just be stuck with a “maybe.”
lines.zh: : 以这种迂回的方式去相信，问题在于你永远没法真正证明自己是对是错。你会永远卡在一个“也许”里。
: 那为什么是问题呢？

lines.en: : It’s less of a problem and more of just...a depressing uncertainty. Like, what do you gain from living your life under the pressure of so many “what ifs?”
lines.zh: : 与其说是问题，不如说……一种令人沮丧的不确定性。就是说，活在那么多“如果”的压力之下，你能得到什么？

lines.en: : Well...for me, it’s like...{i}what if{/i} the truth is...the opposite of what you want?
lines.zh: : 嗯……对我来说，就像是……{i}万一{/i}真相是……和你想要的相反呢？

lines.en: : What if the thing you find out winds up making it even harder to be the person you were {i}before{/i} you found out?
lines.zh: : 万一你查出来的那件事，反而让你更难再做回查出来{i}之前{/i}的那个人呢？

lines.en: : So what if people believe in a thing that isn’t actually there? If believing in that thing makes them happy, I say go for it. You don’t need a definitive answer- just a little hope and...
lines.zh: : 那又怎样呢，就算人们相信一件其实不存在的东西？如果相信那件东西能让他们开心，我说就去相信好了。你不需要一个确定的答案——只需要一点点希望，还有……

lines.en: : And the knowledge to know when you should probably stop listening.
lines.zh: : 以及知道什么时候该停止倾听的见识。
我停止了倾听。
{i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
